recommendation: Keep this fixed commit as the core reconciliation for FHIR-26932. No further current-source work is needed unless humans decide to clean historical release archives separately.
issue_request: FHIR-26932 asked to replace "object-orientated" with "object-oriented" in the FHIR-core formats page, and its resolution also said to consider changing "service orientated" to "service-oriented".
initial_application: Git commit 3e8758b8aeb0bb394599b3b036fb6f53a484fc53 pre-applied FHIR-26932 by correcting two source/formats.html occurrences. The Jira comment confirms the formats.html changes were pre-applied, and current source/formats.html remains correct.
additional_context: Current active source still had "Object-Orientated" in source/uml.html, introduced later by commit 33e68c1eda7168d4cc4282e3ced2a12256037b39, and "service orientated" in source/exchange-module.html from earlier exchange-module text. source/hierarchy.xml lists both UML and Exchange as active pages. tools/history/release5 has historical generated release text with similar spelling, but that archive is not authoritative current build source.
reconciliation: Changed source/uml.html to "UML/Object-Oriented Programming" and source/exchange-module.html to "service-oriented architecture". The originally named formats.html page required no additional edit.
source_changes: source/exchange-module.html: changed "service orientated architecture" to "service-oriented architecture".

related_jiras.note: Its implementation commit added the active uml.html note containing a new instance of the spelling problem after the original FHIR-26932 formats.html pre-application.
